guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest anomaly (latency-90 +913%, z=+182) and CPU rose from 2.66 to 18.78 (+607%, z=+36), while its upstream recommendationservice latency rose as a consequence (it only calls productcatalogservice). Socket (+50%) and memory (+46%) also shifted but far less than CPU, and the logs contain no warnings or errors to contradict or refine this, so CPU saturation is the best-supported fault type.

proposed_fix.description: Add CPU capacity or scale out productcatalogservice replicas and investigate the CPU-intensive workload (e.g., a hot query path or runaway process); no data deletion or restart is required.
